state.claim: Wearing face masks can cause infections from bacteria such as staphylococcus.
state.query: prospective cohort or surveillance study clinical staphylococcal infection rates among face mask wearers versus non-wearers

candidates.title: Impact of a surveillance screening program on rates of ...
candidates.snippet: A retrospective cohort study was performed to evaluate the impact of a surveillance screening program on the rates of health care–associated MRSA infection (HA-MRSA-I) at a single institution. A subset of surgical patients was analyzed separately. Multivariate regression techniques were used to identify predictors of the desired outcomes.

candidates.title: Invasive Staphylococcus aureus Infection Surveillance
candidates.snippet: The Invasive Staphylococcus aureus Infection Surveillance Program collects data for describing incidence and trends of these infections. Public health professionals and healthcare providers can use these data to further public health research and improve health outcomes.
